author: IGNOU School of Social Sciences (SOSS - Library Division)
content:
Studying from your phone or laptop is no longer a novelty. Many working librarians now prefer a flexible, digital route to a postgraduate qualification, and an Online MLIS from IGNOU is one option they're exploring. Indira Gandhi National Open University is India's largest open university, and it has been expanding its online offerings alongside its traditional distance programmes. This guide explains the IGNOU Online MLIS in plain words: how it works, who can apply, the application process, exams and what you can do after it.

What Is an Online MLIS from IGNOU?

An Online MLIS from IGNOU is a Master of Library and Information Science programme delivered mainly through a modern digital learning platform. It builds upon foundational library science education (such as a BLIS degree) and covers advanced information sources, digital cataloguing and classification, information technology, research methods, and modern knowledge centre management, with practical work wherever required.

Instead of relying on printed books and visiting a study centre every weekend, you access learning content, recorded or live faculty webinars, e-books, and assignment portals online. The degree is awarded directly by IGNOU, a central university recognised by the UGC. Because online programmes need separate statutory approval, subject availability, course modules, and evaluation structure can differ slightly from the regular distance MLIS programme. Always confirm current offerings on the official portal.

Online vs Distance: What's the Difference?

Many students confuse the two formats, so it is helpful to clarify:

📦 Distance Mode (ODL)
  • • Physical printed study materials delivered by mail
  • • Periodic counseling at regional study centres
  • • Handwritten assignments submitted at study centres
  • • Pen-and-paper Term-End Examinations at exam centres
💻 Online Mode (OL / IOP)
  • • 100% digital e-content, e-catalogs & student LMS
  • • Live interactive web lectures & discussion forums
  • • Digital assignment upload and online project submissions
  • • Flexible online or designated centre assessment options

The exact exam format can vary by programme, so make sure you review the guidelines for your batch before planning your preparation.

Why Choose the IGNOU Online MLIS?

Here's why library professionals and information managers choose the IGNOU Online MLIS:

  • ✓ Study from anywhere: Access course materials and live webinars on a phone, tablet, or laptop from any location.
  • ✓ Freedom and balance: Complete coursework around ongoing library duties, cataloguing shifts, or family responsibilities.
  • ✓ Affordable investment: Complete master's fee of ₹11,100 makes it far cheaper than private universities charging ₹40,000 to ₹80,000.
  • ✓ Digital content on-demand: Revisit recorded cataloguing demonstrations, database tutorials, and lectures anytime.
  • ✓ UGC-DEB recognized degree: Official post-graduate qualification recognized for UGC-NET and university librarian appointments.

Eligibility for Online MLIS from IGNOU

Standard Duration 1 Year (2 Semesters)
Maximum Time Up to 2 Years
Age Limit No Upper Age Limit

Admission requirements for the programme are clearly structured:

  • 🎓 Candidates should hold a Bachelor's Degree in Library and Information Science (BLIS) or its equivalent qualification from a recognized university.
  • 🎯 Minimum aggregate marks of 50% (45% for reserved category candidates: SC/ST/OBC/PH) are generally expected.
  • 🚫 There is no entrance exam required; admission is granted directly on merit and eligibility.

This makes the IGNOU Online MLIS mainly suitable for BLIS graduates, assistant librarians, document control specialists, and working library staff who want a fast-track master's qualification to become eligible for senior gazetted and university positions.

What You Need to Study Online

Before you begin your online master's journey, ensure your digital setup is ready:

  • 📶 Reliable Wi-Fi or Broadband: For streaming webinars, navigating digital repository platforms, and uploading coursework.
  • 💻 Laptop or Desktop: A computer with a functional browser is necessary for practicing database search strings, MARC21 cataloguing, and open-source library automation tools (like Koha and DSpace).
  • ⏰ Consistent Study Routine: Allocate 1–2 hours daily or concentrated blocks on weekends to keep up with reading modules.
  • 📧 Active Email & Mobile Number: Official notices, LMS login links, and exam dates are delivered electronically.

Subjects You Can Expect to Study

The MLIS curriculum bridges classical information science with modern digital technologies and semantic web architecture:

📚 Information Sources, Systems & Services
🏷️ Advanced Information Processing & Retrieval (Cataloguing / Classification)
💻 ICT Applications in Libraries & Digital Repositories
📈 Research Methodology & Statistical Techniques
🏛️ Management of Library and Information Centres
🌐 Information Literacy, Open Access & Knowledge Repositories

*Note: Specific course codes and optional electives may vary by academic session; verify the current structure on the official admissions portal.

Practicals in the Online MLIS Program of IGNOU

This is the first question every library science candidate should ask. The MLIS curriculum contains crucial practical elements:

  • • Cataloguing and Classification Practice: Hands-on application of AACR-2, RDA, Colon Classification (CC), and Dewey Decimal Classification (DDC).
  • • Database Searching & Metadata Schema: Online indexing, Dublin Core metadata tagging, and Boolean query retrieval.
  • • Digital Library Automation Software: Demonstrations and project setups using open-source tools like Koha, DSpace, and Greenstone.

Find out what the practical component entails for your session before signing up so you can plan your time and travel if supervised or lab sessions are scheduled. Remember to maintain neat practical records - they form a significant part of your final assessment.

How to Apply for Online MLIS from IGNOU (Step-by-Step)

  1. Head over to the official portal: Navigate to ignouiop.samarth.edu.in (the official digital IOP portal).
  2. Register with your details: Create your username and password using your functional email address and mobile number.
  3. Choose the Online MLIS programme: Select the MLISOL course code from the programme catalog.
  4. Fill personal and academic data: Enter your educational qualifications (especially your BLIS degree scores and university details).
  5. Upload scanned documents: Upload your photograph, signature, marksheet, degree, and ID proof in the specified file formats and dimensions.
  6. Pay the programme fee online: Submit the fee using UPI, Net Banking, or Credit/Debit Card. Save the payment receipt and admission confirmation form.

Documents Required for Application

  • 📄 Graduation Marksheet and Degree / Provisional Certificate (including BLIS certificate)
  • 📷 Recent passport-size colour photograph
  • ✍️ Scanned specimen signature
  • 🆔 Valid government-issued ID proof (Aadhaar Card, Passport, or Voter ID)
  • 🏷️ Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PH), if applying under fee exemption or quota

Admission Sessions and Fee Schedule

IGNOU admits students twice a year, in the January session and the July session.

Fee Component Amount / Schedule
Registration Fee ₹300 (one-time upon registration)
Total Programme Fee ₹11,100 (complete 1-year master's fee)
Examination Fee ₹200 per theory / practical exam paper

*Fees and dates are subject to revision from time to time; always verify on the official website before payment. University fees must be paid only to the university directly.

Career Scope After IGNOU Online MLIS

An MLIS accelerates your career progression across public and private knowledge organizations:

  • 🏛️ Academic Librarianship: University Librarian, College Librarian, Deputy Librarian, and Head of Library Services.
  • 👨‍🏫 Teaching & Research: Directly eligible to write UGC-NET in Library and Information Science for Assistant Professor posts and PhD research fellowships.
  • 🏢 Corporate & Specialized Information Centres: Knowledge Manager, Document Controller, Technical Information Officer in law firms, research institutes, and MNCs.
  • 📜 National & Government Repositories: Roles in the National Library of India, Parliament Library, CSIR, ICMR, DRDO, and archival registries.
  • 🌐 Digital Archiving & Metadata Architecture: Digital Asset Manager, Taxonomy Specialist, Information Architect in media houses and IT repositories.

Tips for Success in an Online MLIS

  • 📅 Apply well before the last date: Avoid portal congestion and technical hurdles.
  • ⏰ Set a dedicated study time: Dedicate fixed slots each week for studying classification schemes and research papers.
  • ✍️ Take structured notes: Write your own summaries and practice classification numbers instead of just watching webinars.
  • 📝 Submit assignments on time: Internal assessments constitute 30% of your total marks.
  • 📬 Check email and official website regularly: Keep track of project submission deadlines, practical workshops, and term-end examination dates.
🔗

Explore Library Science Curriculum & Admission Resources

For detailed syllabus breakdowns, admission updates, and counseling support, visit the Online MLIS from IGNOU Information Portal ↗ .

View MLIS Program Details → Compare with Distance MLIS → Explore Online BLIS Degree →

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Is Online MLIS from IGNOU valid?

Yes. IGNOU degrees are recognized by the UGC, UGC-DEB, and AIU. The degree is fully valid for government jobs, UGC-NET lectureship, university librarian promotions, and doctoral admissions.

How long does the IGNOU Online MLIS take?

It is a 1-year postgraduate professional programme divided into two semesters, with extra time allowed (up to two years) to finish your course credits.

Can I do an IGNOU Online MLIS while working?

Yes. The flexible online format lets you access learning modules after work hours and on weekends without taking a sabbatical from your job.

Are exams online for Online MLIS from IGNOU?

The exam format can vary by session. Term-end examinations may be held at designated university test centres or through approved digital examination models; verify current guidelines with your regional centre.

Conclusion

An Online MLIS from IGNOU is an affordable, convenient, and digital step to further your career in library and information science. For a master's degree without the obstacle of leaving your job or relocating, the IGNOU Online MLIS is your premier option. Confirm session availability, keep your documents ready, and apply on time.

This is the first and most critical question any science candidate should ask. A lot of science disciplines include a mandatory practical and laboratory component, and it is not always possible to take laboratory practicals 100% online.

⚠️ Essential Practical Guidelines:
  • You may need to attend intensive face-to-face laboratory sessions (7 to 14 days) at an approved regional science centre or designated university laboratory.
  • Certain computational disciplines (e.g. Applied Mathematics or Geoinformatics) may permit virtual lab software simulations.
  • Find out how the practical component will be conducted for your specific subject before taking admission so you can organize leave and travel in advance.
  • Keep your practical records and laboratory journals tidy - they form a significant part of your internal assessment marks.

  2. Set up your student profile: Register using an active email address and valid mobile number.
  3. Choose your online MSc course: Select your specific MSc subject code open for the intake.
  4. Fill personal and academic details: Enter your graduation marks, science subject combinations, and address details.
  5. Upload mandatory scanned documents: Upload your marksheets, certificates, photograph, signature, and ID proof in the requested file formats.
  6. Pay the programme fee online: Pay using UPI, Net Banking, or Credit/Debit card. Save the payment confirmation and application receipt.

Semester Course Fee ₹7,700 per semester (~₹30,800 Total for 4 Semesters)

  • 🔬 Research & Higher Studies: Eligible to appear for CSIR-NET / UGC-NET for Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) and pursue PhD programmes across premier universities and CSIR labs.
  • 👨‍🏫 Teaching & Lectureship: Qualify for assistant professorship in colleges or PGT (Post Graduate Teacher) positions in schools.
  • 🏢 Industrial R&D & Quality Control: Work as quality assurance chemist, analytical researcher, or technical officer in pharmaceuticals, chemical plants, and testing labs.
  • 📊 Data Science & Analytics: M.Sc Mathematics and Statistics graduates are in high demand for statistical modeling, quantitative finance, and data science roles.
  • 🌿 Environmental & Geospatial Consulting: Opportunities in environmental impact assessment (EIA) agencies, GIS mapping, and forestry divisions.

  • ✍️ Active note-taking: Write down formula derivations and concept summaries rather than just passively watching videos.
  • 📝 Submit assignments on time: Continuous evaluations account for 30% of your aggregate course score.
  • 📬 Regular communications check: Regularly monitor your registered email and student LMS portal for vital lab workshop notices.
